<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Mobile UI design for a fresh-food e-commerce app homepage. Fresh and clean style; white is the dominant color, accented with a healthy green theme color. The top section includes the status bar, a welcome message (“早上好，林小姐”), and a search bar. The middle section features a banner ad area displaying images of fresh fruits and vegetables accompanied by promotional text. Below this is a section (“今日特惠”) displaying fresh produce—such as tomatoes, Shanghai bok choy, and bananas—arranged horizontally, showing product images, names, and prices. The bottom section is a list (“附近商户”) displaying store names, distances, and ratings. A standard navigation bar sits at the very bottom, featuring icons for “首页”、“分类”、“购物车”、“我的”. The UI layout is organized and high-fidelity, utilizing a flat design language and professional interaction design. Features include minimalism, clear typography, high resolution, and a vector-graphic style.
```

### View source wording

```text
移动端UI设计，生鲜电商App首页界面，清新简洁风格，以白色为主色调，搭配绿色健康主题色。顶部包含状态栏、欢迎语“早上好，林小姐”及搜索框。页面中部设有横幅广告区，展示新鲜蔬果图片，并配有宣传文字。下方为“今日特惠”板块，横向排列番茄、上海青、香蕉等新鲜农产品，展示商品图片、名称及价格。底部为“附近商户”列表，包含店铺名称、距离和评分。界面最底部为标准导航栏，包含首页、分类、购物车、我的四个图标，UI布局规整，高保真设计，扁平化设计语言，专业界面交互设计，极简主义，清晰的排版，高分辨率，矢量图形风格。
```
